description:
JIL SANDER launches a limited edition collection created in collaboration with four Kyoto artisans and their workshops: Nanjo Kobo, Shirushizome Kobo Sugishita, Miyawaki Baisenan and Somenotsukasa Yoshioka.
An intimate dialogue between JIL SANDER and the unparalleled techniques of traditional crafts passed down through generations. A reverence for nature, refined sincerity, and an inquisitive approach to making are connected with the materials used for this one-of-a-kind collection. 

Nanjo Kobo x JIL SANDER; Orin bell Charm
With over 200 years of history, Nanjo Kobo is a venerable workshop that has crafted Buddhist orin bells and the gongs for the Gion Matsuri. In this collaboration, five types of orin charms were created, inspired by the workshop's "LinNe Chibi" series technology and JIL SANDER's "Tangle" bag, unified with kumihimo braids in the latest collection colors. These pieces are entirely handmade using "Sahari," an alloy hardened by the workshop's unique blend, and traditional casting techniques employing firewood. Their clear resonance and beautiful lingering sound are the crystallisation of Nanjo Kobo's history and technology, honed over years in pursuit of the ultimate tone. For the kumihimo, genuine silk Karauchi is used, with vibrant colors that beautifully harmonise with the JIL SANDER collection. The kumihimo knots—Aioi Musubi, Niju-Kanae Musubi, and Odamaki—each carry wishes for good fortune and the fulfillment of desires.

Shirushizome Kobo Sugishita: Tenu
title: JIL SANDER -  THE KYOTO PROJECT

description:
A fusion of process and purpose. Crafted through industrial precision, imbued with the intimacy of handwork.

The goal was to push an artisanal approach and feeling into the industrial process, fusing high craft and advanced production technologies, breaking the codes of traditional glassmaking. Thanks to a long series of experiments with an exceptionally skilled glass manufacturer, each bottle has an organic, non-symmetrical shape, and a unique glass repartition. At a closer look, small random imperfections make them all singular, as the persons who will make the fragrances their own. The bell-shaped white aluminum cap that covers the container performs a practical and an aesthetic function. It protects the fragrance from light but when it is removed to apply the fragrance, it leads to a gesture that suggests holding a precious and personal creation. Perfectly aligned with the quietly disruptive character of the collection, the design balances opposites, the Jil Sander way.

#JILSANDERFRAGRANCES #OLFACTORYSERIES1

description:
Jil Sander announces today the launch of its ultra-premium fragrance collection, a first olfactory series of six unisex scents, created in partnership with beauty leader Coty.

The development of the fragrance line demonstrates the brand’s expansion across a lifestyle offering, reaching new audiences and creating opportunities in strong beauty markets, including the GCC where Jil Sander is opening in Dubai later next month. Conceived to capture Jil Sander’s excellence in craft and modernity in luxury, both the scent collection and unique bottle design fully represent the brand’s signature DNA.

This product extension signifies another milestone in Jil Sander’s growth trajectory, following the introduction of fine jewelry last month. With the new fragrance collection, Jil Sander – the pinnacle of luxury in OTB Group’s portfolio of brands – marks a new chapter fueling opportunity for additional new categories in the future.

The first Jil Sander fragrance collection fuses botany and technology in six minimalist, unisex formulas in which the olfactory marks of aldehydes cut across key natural ingredients, giving every fragrance unique shapes and volumes.

Discover more at www.jilsander.com

#JILSANDERFRAGRANCES #JILSANDERBYLUCIEANDLUKEMEIER #OLFACTORYSERIES1
